title.narrative: Low Emissions Climate Resilient Development in the Pacific Phase II

description.narrative: Phase II of the Low Emissions Climate Resilient Development in the Pacific program (LECRD) will build on phase I in supporting Pacific Islands Countries (PICs) to develop the policy, legislation, regulations, strategies, roadmaps and investment pipelines planning necessary to support their transition to low-emissions climate resilient economies and societies. Phase II will continue to focus on policy-level support while expanding the program into more PICs and to implement with delivery partners.

The overall goal of the programme is to support Pacific Island countries to transition to low-emissions climate resilient development through assistance with long-term inclusive planning and decision-making. The programme has four key objectives. These are: 1. increase government's ability to make decisions about long-term opportunities and priorities through evidence-driven, inclusive, and participatory consultation processes; 2. increase government capacity and capability (knowledge, skills, systems) to develop plans to deliver on their climate priorities; 3. support governments to work with sectoral stakeholders (e.g., private sector institutions, and universities) to enable them to implement plans (policies, regulations, standards, etc.); and 4. support government's capacity for developing and implementing LECR plans and strategies that respond to the priorities of women, youth, and marginalized groups, and demonstrate the benefits that this delivers.
